memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, is to have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering and the anointing oil. He is to be in charge of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including its holy furnishings and articles. - Num 4:16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Eleazar, Aaron's son, was given oversight of the whole tabernacle — the oil, the incense, the offerings, and all the holy furnishings. It was a huge responsibility. While others carried individual items, Eleazar was responsible for the care of everything.

Oversight is a weighty calling. To be in charge of much is not merely a position of honour; it is a burden of accountability. Eleazar could not simply do his own task and forget the rest — he had to watch over the whole, making sure nothing was neglected or mishandled.

Some of us are given oversight in various ways — over a family, a team, a ministry, a workplace, or the care of others. It can feel heavy. But God does not give responsibility without also giving grace to carry it. The One who entrusts us with oversight also helps us to be faithful.

Faithfulness, not perfection, is what God asks of those given much. The New Testament reminds us that "it is required that those who have been given a trust must prove faithful" (1 Cor 4:2). God is looking for people He can rely on.

If God has placed something in your charge today, take it seriously and carry it prayerfully. Steward it well, leaning on His strength, and He will help you be faithful.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What has God placed in your charge or oversight?
- Do you carry your responsibilities prayerfully and faithfully?
- How can you rely on God's grace for what feels heavy?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, help me to be faithful with whatever You place in my charge. Give me grace to carry my responsibilities well, leaning on You. Amen.
